name: player_bind_active_game_state_as_current_save_state
description: Player::BindActiveGameStateAsCurrentSaveState marks the active global save state as bound and stores it as g_CurrentPlayerSaveState.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x406450 verifies loading g_GameStateOrMapTable, setting activeSaveState->playerState offset 0x510 to 1, and assigning g_CurrentPlayerSaveState to the active save state. The native smoke covers the binding flag and global pointer update.
